old_review_preserved.note: 固定模型下，Agent 根据当前执行轨迹触发复审，直接改写工具、控制流和状态管理代码；kernel 验证 commit 后热加载，更新后的 Harness 控制后续执行与后续复审，具备反馈驱动的程序工件更新和跨改进轮次保留。独立跨任务迁移未证实，不写成泛化成功；PerfRace 上的项目代码优化与 Harness 更新须区分。 证据与保留历史：docs/internal/reports/maintenance-2026-11-10/；仅限定分支纳入，不声称重算所有论文数字。

summary_override.summary_en: BOXBOX lets an agent request reviews and rewrite its executable harness in response to difficulties during a long-running task. A kernel validates the changes and hot-reloads the runtime while preserving execution context; the revised harness governs later execution and reviews. PerfRace comparisons use matched task-time budgets against frozen, offline-evolved, and externally controlled harness baselines. This supports within-task inheritance across improvement rounds; independent cross-task transfer remains unknown and equal time does not imply equal dollar cost.
summary_override.summary_zh: BOXBOX 让 Agent 在长时任务中根据执行困难主动复审并改写自己的可执行 Harness。kernel 验证改动后保留上下文、热加载新运行时，后续执行和复审继续使用新版。PerfRace 上与固定 Harness、离线 Harness Evolution 和外部控制的 Harness Scaling 比较，使用相同任务时间预算；这是任务内跨轮 Harness 演化证据，独立跨任务迁移仍为 unknown，不能把时间预算相同写成费用完全相同。
